title: #14 Patrik Wahlén on Business Adventures
summary:

thesis: The episode discusses the book Business Adventures by John Brooks, highlighting themes of risk management, trust, and market self-correction through stories like the oil scandal, the 1962 market fluctuation, and the Ford Edsel failure. The guest notes that while market economies efficiently correct mistakes, investors must remain cautious of management overconfidence and sunk cost fallacies when evaluating such ventures.
